item.title: Penn State Wrestling Sets NCAA Division I Record for Consecutive Dual Meet Wins
item.description: Add another historic achievement to Cael Sanderson's tenure as Penn State wrestling coach. The Nittany Lions won their 77th consecutive dual meet with a 42-0 victory over Stanford on Saturday night, eclipsing the previous NCAA Division I record of 76 set by Oklahoma State from 1937-51. Wrestling at the Journeymen Duals in Nashville, Penn State tied the Sooners' mark earlier in the evening with a 46-0 win over North Dakota State. item.title: Last of Centre County’s Commemorative Liberty Bells Unveiled Ahead of America 250 Celebration
item.description: Community members joined state and local officials in Bellefonte on Friday night to unveil the last of four commemorative bells in Centre County that are part of the celebration of the United States' 250th birthday in 2026. item.title: Mount Nittany Medical Center Reveals Most Popular Baby Names of 2025
item.description: One of last year's top names for babies born in Centre County continued to be popular in 2025, while a host of new entries made the lists for both boys and girls, according to Mount Nittany Medical Center. More than 1,300 babies were delivered this year at the State College area hospital, and on Wednesday, Mount Nittany Health revealed the most popular boys' and girls' names for those newborns. item.description: Centre Foundation has awarded $183,130 in Field-of-Interest (FOI) grants to 41 local programs and projects, funded by 22 donor-established endowments that support specific causes, populations and geographic areas throughout Centre County and surrounding regions.
